mapper.insert: insert into xl_companion_post (user_id, destination_id, title, content, travel_date_start, travel_date_end, budget_range, contact_remark, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{destinationId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{travelDateStart}, #{travelDateEnd}, #{budgetRange}, #{contactRemark}, #{status}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select id, user_id, destination_id, title, content, travel_date_start, travel_date_end, budget_range, contact_remark, status, create_time, update_time from xl_companion_post where id = #{id}

select id, user_id, destination_id, title, content, travel_date_start, travel_date_end, budget_range, contact_remark, status, create_time from xl_companion_post
and status = #{status} and destination_id = #{destinationId} and (title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or content like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) and (travel_date_end is null or travel_date_end >= #{dateFrom}) and (travel_date_start is null or travel_date_start <= #{dateTo})
order by create_time desc
mapper.delete: delete from xl_companion_post where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
